As a strategic member of the team, you will guide the integration of compliance obligations in
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE: We are seeking an articulate, thorough and highly organized individual who is results driven with a passion for risk mitigation. The Director of PBM Compliance and Regulatory Affairs will be a critical leader of Rightway’s Compliance team. As a strategic member of the team, you will guide the integration of compliance obligations into the organization’s operational, contractual, data, technology, and client-facing processes. You will provide leadership and oversight to promote continuous regulatory readiness, strengthen risk management practices, establish and maintain effective compliance controls, validate compliance through evidence-based reviews, and foster a proactive culture of compliance within a complex and rapidly evolving regulatory environment. This role is instrumental in establishing a best in class compliance department and have the tactical skills to execute on the departmental needs through system integration, policy establishment and results monitoring. WHAT YOU’LL DO: Perform federal and state regulatory research proactively anticipate business needs and requirements, identify and communicate potential risks/needs to key stakeholders, develop policies and procedures as well as strategic plans to mitigate risks and address needs Specific to business registration and licensure requirements, routinely conduct and monitor state and federal regulations, in addition, prepare, file and manage business registrations and licenses including the submission of required reporting Partner with department leads to ensure compliance with all statutory and regulatory requirements, pharmacy compliance activities and PBM compliance initiatives across the business; develop and maintain department approved regulatory and legislative compliance plan; create, implement, and maintain effective internal controls including policies and procedures Partner with department leads to ensure terms and conditions within vendor and client contracts as well as other pertinent agreements comply with applicable state and federal regulations Track, monitor and communicate across departments i) policies and procedures; ii) performance and reporting requirements; and iii) key metrics Participate as compliance subject matter expert on all mandated projects and escalated matters; achieve business operational compliance with all related measures relative to PBM accreditation initiatives Maintain an understanding and knowledge of regulatory affairs in all applicable jurisdictions and regulatory environments; lead and facilitate the development of company positions as well as internal and external responses related to pending regulatory initiatives Develop and implement training and communication plans; manage and lead scheduled and ad-hoc compliance projects; provide and deliver compliance consultation services to all departments Provide strategic compliance leadership and guidance to Rightway clients and business partners, fostering a culture of compliance, regulatory accountability, and operational excellence. Promote continuous improvement of regulatory programs and initiatives by identifying opportunities for improvement; work with key stakeholders across departments to design and implement regulatory process improvement programs and initiatives; and develop recommendations Conduct, direct, lead and facilitate all activities related to Internal and External (Regulatory and Client) audits and responses to findings Lead, mentor, and develop a team of compliance professionals and people leaders through coaching,performance management, succession planning, and talent development. WHO YOU ARE: Education level: Bachelor’s Degree Required (Preferred: Master’s Degree) and JD (Juris Doctorate) degree or equivalent combination of practical experience Work experience: Minimum 7 years of relevant work experience in the healthcare industry with PBM industry experience preferred Important characteristics of ideal candidate: Detail-oriented, analytical, intellectually curious, good listener, empathetic, ability to challenge status quo, values exemplar Specific skills needed for job: Solid communication, research and organizational skills, ability to lead projects and influence others even without direct reporting line ownership Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, fluid environment Advanced computer and Windows skills required COMPENSATION: $185,000 - $220,000 annually, in addition to bonus and equity Compensation offered will be determined by geographic location, experience, and qualifications. CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS NOTICE In response to ongoing and industry-wide fraudulent recruitment activities (i.e., job scams), Rightway wants to inform potential candidates that we will only contact them from the @rightwayhealthcare.com email domain. We will never ask for bank details or deposits of any kind as a condition of employment. ABOUT RIGHTWAY: Rightway is on a mission to harmonize healthcare for everyone, everywhere. Our products guide patients to the best care and medications by inserting clinicians and pharmacists into a patient’s care journey through a modern, mobile app. Rightway is a front door to healthcare, giving patients the tools they need along with on-demand access to Rightway health guides, human experts that answer their questions and manage the frustrating parts of healthcare for them. Since its founding in 2017, Rightway has raised over $300mm from investors including Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, Francisco Partners, and Tiger Global. We’re headquartered in New York City, with satellite offices in Denver and Dallas. Our clients rely on us to transform the healthcare experience, improve outcomes for their teams, and decrease their healthcare costs. HOW WE LIVE OUR VALUES TO OUR TEAMMATES: We’re seeking those with passion for healthcare and relentless devotion to our goal. We need team members that embody our core values: 1) We are human, first Our humanity binds us together. We bring the same empathetic approach to every individual we engage with, whether it be our members, our clients, or each other. We are all worthy of respect and understanding and we engage in our interactions with care and intention. We honor our stories. We listen to—and hear—each other, we celebrate our differences and similarities, we are present for each other, and we strive for mutual understanding. 2) We redefine what is possible We always look beyond the obstacles in front of us to imagine new solutions. We approach our work with inspiration from other industries, other leaders, and other challenges. We use ingenuity and resourcefulness when faced with tough problems. 3) We debate then commit We believe that a spirit of open discourse is part of a healthy culture. We understand and appreciate different perspectives and we challenge our assumptions. When working toward a decision or a new solution, we actively listen to one another, approach it with a “yes, and” mentality, and assume positive intent. Once a decision is made, we align and champion it as one team. 4) We cultivate grit Changing healthcare doesn’t happen overnight. We reflect and learn from challenges and approach the future with a determination to strive for better. In the face of daunting situations, we value persistence. We embrace failure as a stepping stone to future success. On this journey, we seek to act with guts, resilience, initiative, and tenacity. 5) We seek to delight Healthcare is complicated and personal. We work tirelessly to meet the goals of our clients while also delivering the best experience to our members. We recognize that no matter the role or team, we each play a crucial part in our members’ care and take that responsibility seriously. When faced with an obstacle, we are kind, respectful, and solution-oriented in our approach. We hold ourselves accountable to our clients and our members’ success. Rightway is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in the strength of diverse thought, beliefs, backgrounds, and education. We foster an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated to drive the best business decisions possible. We do not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, need, and performance.

items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b About the Company The client is a New Zealand-based wellness brand specialising in nutritional supplements and wellness products. The company is committed to developing high-quality, science-led products that support everyday health and wellbeing. With a growing presence across New Zealand and Australia, they continue to expand its e-commerce, wholesale, and retail operations while maintaining a strong focus on product quality and customer experience. About the Role We are looking for a highly organised and proactive E-commerce & Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of a growing wellness brand across New Zealand and Australia. This is a broad, hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working across multiple areas of a business, including e-commerce, customer experience, wholesale account management, supply chain, inventory coordination, and project administration. Working closely with the Head of Operations, you will play an important role in keeping business operations running smoothly, coordinating with customers, retailers, suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics partners, and ensuring that operational processes, documentation, and reporting are maintained accurately. The ideal candidate is commercially minded, detail-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks in a fast-paced, growing business. Key Responsibilities 1. E-commerce & Customer Experience Manage customer enquiries across email, live chat, helpdesk, website, and social media channels. Oversee online order processing, tracking, amendments, cancellations, refunds, returns, and subscription changes. Coordinate with couriers and third-party logistics (3PL) providers to resolve delivery issues and fulfilment discrepancies. Monitor customer feedback, identify recurring issues, and prepare monthly customer insights reports. 2. Brand & Influencer Coordination Manage day-to-day communications across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, following established brand guidelines. Coordinate influencer and UGC creator outreach, applications, product gifting, campaign timelines, and deliveries. Maintain creator databases, campaign trackers, usage rights, posting schedules, and partnership documentation. Support PR activities, brand collaborations, and monthly influencer reporting. 3. Wholesale & Retail Operations Coordinate new wholesale account enquiries, onboarding, and ongoing retailer relationships. Process wholesale orders, confirmations, and invoicing using Unleashed. Maintain wholesale pricing, product information, retailer documentation, and promotional materials. Coordinate with distributors, retail partners, warehouses, and logistics providers to ensure timely order fulfilment. Support wholesale reporting, sales performance tracking, and retailer re-order activities. 4. Supply Chain & Inventory Coordination Assist with production scheduling, purchase orders, supplier follow-ups, and import/export logistics. Monitor stock levels, inventory movements, batch tracking, expiry dates, and warehouse accuracy. Liaise with manufacturers, suppliers, freight providers, and 3PL partners across New Zealand and Australia. Track production timelines, warehouse transfers, delivery documentation, and supplier milestones. Support demand forecasting, inventory reporting, and monthly supply and operations planning. 5. Project & Business Operations Coordinate new product development activities, including product documentation, specifications, costing records, and production timelines. Support product launches, packaging readiness, and operational project administration. Maintain operational trackers, master data, dashboards, SOPs, and shared documentation. Assist with business-wide projects, process improvements, system integration, and operational reporting. Provide regular progress updates and administrative support to the Head of Operations. 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, e-commerce operations, supply chain, or a similar role. Experience in supplements, nutraceuticals, health and wellness, food and beverage, or FMCG industries is highly desirable. Hands-on experience with Shopify, including order management, customer service, subscriptions, and e-commerce reporting. Background in wholesale/B2B operations, account management, order processing, invoicing, and retailer coordination. Knowledge of inventory management, stock forecasting, purchase orders, supplier coordination, and warehouse fulfilment. Familiarity with inventory management or ERP systems, particularly Unleashed, is an advantage. Excellent organisational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently. What We're Looking For We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in growing consumer brands, especially within the wellness, supplements, food and beverage, or FMCG industries. You don't necessarily need experience in every area of the role, but you should bring a strong foundation in e-commerce and business operations, with the versatility to support different functions and take ownership of day-to-day responsibilities. If you're someone who enjoys bringing structure to operations, solving problems, coordinating people and processes, and contributing to the growth of a dynamic business, we'd love to hear from you. Remote / WFH New Zealand Business Hours To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-e-commerce-operations-coordinator-pharma-supplements-nz

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote, US About Mixpanel Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Team The Customer Value Architects team sits inside the revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. We turn product usage into measurable business outcomes, working across onboarding, adoption, and renewal to make sure customers see the value they signed up for. About the Role The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a defined book of accounts. You'll own the adoption and value plan for each account end to end: understanding why the customer bought Mixpanel, tracking whether they're getting the ROI they expected, and driving the enablement and product usage that gets them there. You'll build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, partner closely with your Account Executive and renewal counterparts, and bring a growing point of view on how customers should think about AI in their product workflows. This role suits someone who can own a project end to end and is ready to start extending their influence beyond their own accounts to the wider team. Responsibilities Own the value plan for each account in your portfolio, connecting the business problem that led the customer to buy Mixpanel with the outcomes they measure. Build relationships with business and technical stakeholders, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to what customers care about most. Run discovery on customer priorities and pain points, and turn what you learn into concrete adoption plans and internal updates. Partner with your Account Executive on expansion and your renewal counterpart on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that supports both. Lead enablement/best practices sessions on dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling to grow how deeply and widely a customer uses Mixpanel. Monitor usage and health signals and lead business reviews that surface what's working, deepen adoption, and catch risk early. Spot underused features and contracted capabilities, and turn them into clear recommendations for the customer. Triage product questions and issues, solving what you can and routing the rest to the right team. Build a working point of view on a customer's AI maturity, and use Mixpanel's own AI surface to help them build on their product data. Coordinate with GTM, Product, and Engineering on escalations, and share what works with the broader Customer Value Architects team. We're Looking For Someone Who Has 4 - 6 years of experience in customer success, consulting, or a related field supporting B2B SaaS accounts, or equivalent experience. A track record of managing relationships across a range of stakeholders, from business partners to technical teams. The ability to translate technical concepts, like data models and product metrics, into terms that land with non-technical stakeholders. Experience turning product usage into a clear story about customer outcomes and ROI. Comfort building and running adoption plans that tie daily work to a customer's larger goals. Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use, such as MCP-based workflows or LLM copilots. A collaborative approach to working across account teams and internal partners to move plans forward. Good judgment for prioritizing which accounts and actions need attention first. Bonus Points For Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development. Experience in a technical advisory or professional services capacity. Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling. #LI-Remote Benefits and Perks Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care Mental Wellness Benefit Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays Enhanced Parental Leave Volunteer Time Off Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break *please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary* Culture Values Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress. Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes. One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone. Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations. Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star. Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible. Why choose Mixpanel? We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions. Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mixpanel-customer-value-architect-iii-1

PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier V
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote - USA PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess/MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all sizes. PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Brand Designer to help shape and evolve the visual identity of PlanetScale across all touchpoints. In this role, you'll be a key member of our Marketing team, translating complex technical concepts into compelling visual stories that resonate with developers and technical decision-makers. You'll craft everything from in-person event experiences to web graphics, merch designs, and creative website assets that make databases feel exciting. What's the job to be done? Visual Brand Development Design web graphics including technical diagrams, illustrations, and interactive visual assets that simplify complex database concepts. Create compelling visual systems for campaigns, product launches, and marketing initiatives. Design for multiple formats and contexts: digital, print, experiential, and merchandise. In-Person Experiences Design booth graphics, signage, and environmental branding for conferences, meetups, and community events. Collaborate with the events team to create memorable, on-brand experiences that stand out Design merch that developers actually want to wear and use. Create branded collateral including banners, posters, stickers, and promotional materials. Website and Digital Assets Design creative website components and landing pages. Design data visualizations and technical diagrams that make complex information accessible. Create social media graphics, blog post imagery, and other digital marketing assets. Develop templates and design systems that enable the team to move quickly. Brand Evolution Collaborate with marketing leadership to evolve and expand the PlanetScale brand identity. Explore new visual directions while maintaining brand coherence. Document design decisions and maintain brand guidelines. These attributes best describe you. A strong portfolio demonstrating versatile design skills across digital, print, and experiential design. Deep understanding of design fundamentals: typography, color, composition, and visual hierarchy. You've figured out where AI actually helps in a design workflow and built process around it. Comfortable working in both brand and production modes. You can think big picture and execute in the details. Strong communication skills with the ability to both articulate design decisions and understand direction. Self-directed and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines. Collaborative spirit with the ability to incorporate feedback while maintaining creative vision. What else will help you be successful. Experience designing for technical or developer-focused brands. Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and other design tools. Comfortable using AI to build a working first draft of a page rather than handing off a static mockup. Understanding of design systems and component-based thinking. Enthusiasm for learning about databases, infrastructure, and developer tools. Why PlanetScale We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Brand Designer, you'll help shape how developers and engineering leaders perceive and interact with PlanetScale, translating the power of our platform into visual experiences that inspire and inform. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America. At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status. If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate! items.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
items.summary: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. items.description: Make Every Experience Matter Viseven — ШІ-орієнтована компанія, що допомагає організаціям у сферах life sciences, фармацевтики та біотехнологій об’єднати фрагментовані контент-процеси і побудувати омніканальну взаємодію з лікарями та пацієнтами, яка відповідає регуляторним стандартам і приносить реальний результат. Поєднуючи власні технологічні рішення — eWizard, eVa, Kheiron і Lexi — зі стратегічним консалтингом і глибокою експертизою, ми супроводжуємо контент на кожному етапі: від створення та MLR-валідації до локалізації й омніканальної публікації. Серед наших клієнтів — провідні компанії зі списку Top 50 у сфері life sciences по всьому світу. Обов’язки: Аналіз даних та розробка звітів за запитами внутрішніх і зовнішніх клієнтів. Надання експертної допомоги в розробці алгоритмів і методів розрахунку показників звітності. Розробка та впровадження алгоритмів і механізмів верифікації даних звітів. Аналіз і розробка процедур вивантаження даних для звітів, підготовка пропозицій щодо їх оптимізації. Підготовка пропозицій щодо вдосконалення функціоналу вже створених звітів. Написання та підтримання в актуальному стані документації на розроблений функціонал. Участь у відновленні працездатності системи в разі збоїв та нестандартних ситуацій. Написання статей про розроблений функціонал. Вимоги: 2 роки досвіду роботи. Глибоке знання функціоналу моделюючих інструментів (modelling instruments). Відмінні знання та досвід роботи з Excel. Добре знання основ аналізу даних. Глибокі знання та досвід роботи з базами даних. Чітке розуміння та застосування принципів API та REST API. Знання Python або інших інструментів. Здатність аналізувати та вирішувати всі функціональні завдання середньої складності, вміння братися за складні завдання через дослідження теми, здатність проєктувати функціонал робочих інструментів. Взаємодія з внутрішніми клієнтами та планування. Використання формальних і неформальних методів письмової комунікації (наприклад, електронні листи, інформаційні бюлетені, презентації PowerPoint, оновлення для керівництва, списки завдань, статус-апдейти) для комунікації щодо оновлень і результатів досліджень. Опис вимог у форматі Agile: Epic, Story, сценарії у форматі “Given-When-Then”. Здатність інтерпретувати інформацію у довільній формі моделей, діаграм та таблиць. Англійська мова (рівень Intermediate).

items.summary: Role Title: Equity & Credit Research Expert Role Type: ContractorLocation: Remotemicro1 is engaging Equity & Credit Research Experts to participate in a dynamic project for one of its customers.
items.description: Role Title: Equity & Credit Research Expert Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Equity & Credit Research Experts to participate in a dynamic project for one of its customers. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. As an Equity & Credit Research Expert, you will leverage your deep knowledge of financial markets, analytical methods, and sector-specific trends to provide nuanced, high-value insights that inform the development of advanced technology solutions. Scope of Work Analyze and evaluate financial statements, earnings reports, and market data for public and private companies. Deliver comprehensive equity and credit research commentary using industry-standard frameworks and methodologies. Draft and review investment theses, risk assessments, and valuation reports to support robust AI training datasets. Provide real-world examples and assess case studies relevant to equity and credit analysis scenarios. Critically assess and annotate research documents, highlighting key drivers, risks, and market catalysts. Collaborate in feedback cycles to enhance accuracy, clarity, and relevance of project deliverables. Contribute to the continuous improvement of project workflows by sharing professional insights and best practices. Preferred Qualifications Extensive background in equity and/or credit research, with proven experience in financial analysis and investment research. Strong understanding of financial modeling, credit risk evaluation, and sector-specific market trends. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity, precision, and actionable insights. Familiarity with major financial data platforms (e.g., Bloomberg, FactSet, S&P Capital IQ). Advanced degree or relevant certification (e.g., CFA, CPA, MBA) is advantageous. Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex topics into clear, structured deliverables for technical and non-technical audiences. Experience contributing to collaborative projects and providing constructive feedback is a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: 🌍 Finance Research Expert, Remote- Contract
items.summary: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills:• Equity Research • FP&A • Corporate Finance • Accounting or Audit • Investor Relations • Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot:• Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours • Location: Remote, worldwide • You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP • Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work:• You will work on questions about real US public companies.
items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

We are currently looking for a Marketing Assistant to support marketing and communications efforts. This is a hands-on execution and ownership role for a seasoned marketing professional who can independently manage campaigns, create high-quality content, and help elevate brand presence across all channels. This is not an entry-level role - we are looking for someone who understands marketing strategy, executes at a high level, and brings ideas forward - not just deliverables. In Teamswell, every team member has an instrumental role and impact on the success of our business and our clients’ success, so we seek to have highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced work environment, who are intelligent, eager to work hard, reliable, and able to communicate effectively with all levels of an organization. Our Marketing Assistant will possess the skills and experience required, as well as a positive attitude and ability to solve complex problems and work in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. We value people who are good communicators, quick learners, scrappy about finding creative solutions to problems, and conscious of their work quality. We expect all our team members to deliver excellence in both technical expertise as well as in their everyday relationships with their team. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Texas URL: https://kyro.ai Sales Development Representative (SDR) Location: Remote, non-US based, working US Central Time business hours Experience: 1-3 years in a B2B SDR/BDR role Employment type: Full-time Reports to: Product Manager - Growth ABOUT KYRO AI When a major storm knocks out power, utilities race to mobilize crews and get the lights back on. Kyro AI builds the software behind that effort: workforce and contractor management for electric utilities, storm restoration contractors, and aggregators. We are headquartered in Plano, Texas, and were spun off from Think Power Solutions, so we pair long-standing utility expertise with the pace and ownership of a product company. https://kyro.ai/ WHY JOIN KYRO - Work that matters: our platform helps communities get power back after storms and keeps a critical, regulated industry compliant. - A growing product suite: StormShield for storm restoration, Kyro Capital for contractor invoice factoring, KORY (our AI copilot), and contractor onboarding and verification. - Credibility from day one: you sell with the backing of real utility relationships and domain know-how. - Close to leadership: direct access to the CEO and product team, and what you hear from customers shapes the roadmap. - Room to grow: a clear path from SDR to Account Executive. - Flexibility: fully remote team. THE ROLE As an SDR, you are the first conversation most utilities and contractors have with Kyro. You will work two segments with very different buying motions: Utilities (enterprise): You will talk to storm response, emergency management, contractor management, supply chain, and procurement leaders. Cycles are long, involve multiple stakeholders, and are often tied to RFIs/RFPs. A win is a qualified discovery meeting or demo handed to the account team. Contractors (SMB to mid-market): You will talk to owners, operations managers, and storm coordinators at line, vegetation, and restoration contractors. Cycles are shorter, phone-first, and owner-led. A win is a demo held and the contractor signed up and onboarded. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Prospect outbound: research target utilities and contractors, build account lists, and reach decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn. - Own the follow-up: run multi-touch cadences, chase no-shows and stalled conversations, and make sure every lead has a dated next step. - Respond to inbound leads the same business day and qualify them before they go cold. - Qualify with rigor: confirm need, timeline, decision process, budget, and compliance requirements before booking. - Book and confirm demos, send reminders, and hand off with clear notes. - Drive conversions: stay with contractors after the demo until they sign up and start onboarding; keep utility opportunities moving to the next stage. - Keep the CRM clean: log every activity, stage change, and next step. - Feed the product team: share objections, competitor mentions, and feature requests from the field. HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED Success is measured on demos held and the conversions that follow. Activity counts are leading indicators, not the goal. KPIs: demos booked, demos held, demo-to-opportunity rate, conversions (contractors signed up and onboarded; utility opportunities advanced to proposal or pilot), pipeline sourced, speed to lead, follow-up coverage (share of open leads with a dated next step), and outreach activity. Targets are set separately for each segment; utility credit weighs meetings and pipeline more than closed conversions. WHAT YOU BRING - 1-3 years as an SDR or BDR in B2B sales, ideally SaaS, with a record of hitting or beating meeting and demo quotas - Disciplined follow-up across phone, email, and LinkedIn without being reminded - Confident cold calling, including with field-oriented buyers who rarely live in their inbox - Clear, concise written communication - Hands-on experience with a CRM and a sales engagement tool (HubSpot, Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar) - Comfort with metrics: you track your own funnel and know where deals stall - Ability to learn a technical, regulated domain quickly - Self-directed and organized in a fully remote setting - Native English speaker, available during US Central Time business hours NICE TO HAVE - Experience selling into utilities, energy, construction, field services, or regulated industries - Familiarity with storm restoration, line work, vegetation management, or contractor ecosystems - Exposure to both enterprise (long-cycle) and SMB or self-serve sales motions - Experience selling workforce management, compliance, or fintech products - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience COMPENSATION AND PROBATION - Competitive market base plus uncapped commission. Base is paid bi-weekly and commission quarterly. - Accelerators: 1.5x at 101-125% of quota, 2.0x above 125%. - The first six months are probationary, with performance reviews at 3 and 6 months against ramped KPI targets (demos held, conversions, follow-up coverage). - If targets are not met, Kyro may extend the probationary period or end employment. - - Employment remains at-will during and after probation. WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive base and variable pay - A fully remote role - A clear path to Account Executive for SDRs who consistently hit target - Direct exposure to product and leadership at a company shaping how utilities run storm response To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative

items.title: SEO & GEO, Senior Account Manager at Seer Interactive

We relentlessly pursue (and share) the truth, bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources, enhanced by respons
items.description: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, technology, and AI to make a mark on our communities, our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors. We relentlessly pursue (and share) the truth, bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources, enhanced by responsible, human-centered AI. Our purpose is to unlock potential across these communities, envisioning a world where doing the right thing is intuitive and informed. At Seer, we see AI as a catalyst for innovation, collaboration, and creativity. Regardless of your division or discipline, leveraging AI is a core part of how we deliver smarter, faster, and more strategic outcomes for our clients. Our AI Council drives company-wide integration by focusing on education, purposeful implementation, and continuous learning, ensuring that AI is embedded in how we think, operate, and grow. If you’re ready to uplift others, challenge your ego, commit to the truth, and be better than yesterday—keep reading. Seer is a remote-first agency and a Certified B-Corp, with team members across the country. If an office environment is more your style, this position can also sit in our HQ office in Philadelphia. We can only consider candidates based in the US who can work continental US-based hours. The Role: You, the Senior SEO & GEO Account Manager of our dreams, are a strategic consultant and will spend your days creating digital marketing strategies that tie into clients’ overall marketing plans and business goals. At Seer, AI is embedded in how we deliver smarter, faster, and more strategic outcomes and search is evolving beyond traditional rankings into AI Overviews, generative results, and LLM-powered discovery experiences. In this role, you are the day-to-day strategic lead on your accounts, deep in the data, driving the project plan, and running the client relationship at the operational level. A Channel Lead may sit above your accounts to handle executive stakeholder relationships and portfolio-level decisions, but you are the engine. Your instinct for what to do next and your ability to communicate it clearly to clients and associates is what makes accounts move You will be passionately engaged with this evolving search landscape and understand how to position brands for visibility across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-driven interfaces. You don’t just optimize for rankings, you think about discoverability, content visibility within AI-generated results, and how search behavior is shifting. You’re intellectually curious, systems-minded, and not afraid to test emerging tools, design AI-driven workflows, or challenge conventional SEO thinking. Role Highlights You have experience managing a portfolio of 4–6 active client accounts simultaneously, keeping deliverables on track across multiple industries and stakeholder contexts without losing the thread on any of them. You will lead organic strategy for a portfolio of clients, building annual and quarterly roadmaps that account for both traditional SEO performance and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) visibility across AI-driven search environments. You will serve as the day-to-day primary point of contact for clients, running weekly status calls, managing the project plan, fielding questions, and keeping strategy on track. While a Channel Lead may own the executive relationship on larger accounts, you are the operational lead your client relies on On any given week, you might respond to a dozen client-related messages, prep a QBR, onboard a new stakeholder, and triage an unexpected client ask, all while keeping deliverables on track. You are comfortable context-switching quickly and know when a fast response is more valuable than a perfect one. Conduct in-depth content gap analyses, competitive research, keyword strategy, and SERP landscape analysis including evaluating how client content surfaces within traditional Search, AI-generated results and other generative search experiences. Translate performance data from GA4, Adobe, and Search Console into clear, actionable insights, connecting ranking shifts, traffic trends, SERP feature changes, and generative visibility signals back to client goals. Strengthen technical foundations such as site architecture, internal linking, and structured data to improve crawlability, entity clarity, and overall discoverability across both traditional search engines and generative platforms. Work closely with 1-2 associates per account, directing their work, reviewing deliverables, and developing their skills. This is not formal people management — their team lead owns that — but you are the day-to-day mentor and quality check. Strong account managers can explain not just what to fix but why. Leverage tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and automation platforms (Zapier, APIs) to accelerate research, synthesize insights, and support scalable SEO and GEO workflows. Test, refine, and document AI-driven workflows and GEO experiments that enhance strategic thinking, surface new opportunities, and shape Seer’s evolving approach to modern organic visibility. Essential Skills You have proven experience building and driving SEO strategy across multiple industries, with the ability to evolve strategy as search shifts toward AI-generated summaries and generative search interfaces. Enterprise-level clients are your comfort zone, you’ve navigated complex stakeholder structures, long deal cycles, and high expectations before, and you know how to deliver at that level. You have a strong technical SEO foundation, including site architecture, structured data, indexing diagnostics, and performance analysis with an understanding of how these elements influence both traditional rankings and generative visibility. You are able to tie SEO and GEO performance to business outcomes and confidently communicate strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable working in Wrike as your daily operating system, managing blueprints, tracking deliverable burn, setting task dependencies, and keeping accounts moving within the interface. On accounts without a dedicated PM (roughly a quarter of your book), you own the project management layer. You are comfortable working with AI and LLM tools beyond surface-level usage, using them to analyze data, pressure-test ideas, support research, and improve workflows. You have strong analytical fluency across platforms such as GA4, Adobe, Search Console, and leading SEO tools, with curiosity around emerging GEO measurement indicators such as AI Overview presence, generative citations, and SERP volatility. You are a critical thinker who evaluates AI-generated insights and GEO opportunities through real business context rather than relying solely on automation. 90 Day Goals By Day 30, you will have completed division training and begun to support at least 1 client By Day 60,you will have onboarded to at least 3 client accounts and are taking over strategy for them By Day 90, you will have ownership of your accounts and be delivering independently This might not be the right role for you if Time-management, context-switching, and juggling multiple projects is quite challenging You do not want continued-learning and innovation to be an expectation Change management is difficult and you struggle with adapting to new tools and processes Your AI usage stops at asking ChatGPT for content drafts or simple edits, or you struggle to adapt when tools break Client communication feels like overhead rather than a core part of the value you deliver. The most successful account managers here genuinely enjoy talking to clients, navigating ambiguity with them, and spending real time on relationship management, not just strategy decks. Compensation & Benefits $95,000-$115,000 annually. Your final offered compensation will be determined by your skills and experience Evaluation of comp at least once a year Benefits highlights $95,000 - $115,000 a year Ready to apply? Ditch the cover letter — we don’t need it. We’d rather see your AI chops. Use our Marketing Career AI Self-Assessment GPT to find out where you land on the AI marketing maturity curve and share your results with us. Our team is excited to read your application responses and will be using them to help determine who we’d like to meet with! _Have questions about recruitment at Seer? Check out our_ Custom GPT: Guide to Talent Acquisition at Seer to drop in your questions! You can ask it anything about our hiring process, and how to best prepare for an interview with us. As a B-Corp Certified organization, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Not ready to apply but want to keep in touch? Stay connected via our monthly Career Update newsletter! We’ll share curated content on Seer, open roles, industry insights, career advice, events you don’t want to miss, and more (so you never miss a beat). Seer is a remote-first organization with an HQ is Philadelphia PA. We are only eligible to hire in the US, excluding Alaska & Hawaii at this time We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.summary: Here at Scout Motors, we’re carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and
items.description: Here at Scout Motors, we’re carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you’re ready to drive change and make history, apply now! Overview Scout Motors is seeking an Employee Care Leader to build and lead the programs that define how Scout attracts, develops, retains, and engages its people. This leader will own compensation, benefits, employee development, and engagement strategy — the programs that signal to every employee that Scout is a place where they belong and can thrive. This role will be responsible for ensuring Scout’s compensation and benefits programs are competitive, equitable, and aligned with the company’s values; that employees have access to development experiences that build their skills and careers; and that the organization has a pulse on engagement and knows how to act on what it hears. This leader will partner closely with the Chief Human Resources Officer, HR Leadership team, Finance, Legal, and HR centers of excellence to build a holistic employee care strategy that scales with Scout’s growth. What you’ll do Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: Leadership & Strategy Lead, develop, and coach a team spanning compensation, benefits, learning and development, and employee engagement and listening. Set a strategic vision for the total employee experience at Scout and align the team’s work to that vision. Partner with the CHRO and HR leadership team to ensure employee care priorities are integrated into Scout’s enterprise-wide people strategy. Champion a culture of inclusion, care, and Scout’s values within the team and across the function. Demonstrated grit, curiosity, and resourcefulness in navigating ambiguity, solving complex problems, and turning obstacles into practical, scalable solutions. Total Rewards Own Scout’s compensation philosophy, structure, and pay programs including base salary and variable pay (both short term and long term incentive) and sales incentive compensation Oversee benefits strategy, plan design, vendor management, and annual enrollment to ensure programs meet employees’ needs and are cost-effective. Lead executive compensation programs in partnership with the HR Leadership team, Legal, Finance, and the Compensation Committee. Responsible for the governance of the Compensation Committee and the Benefits Committee for Scout Motors. Benchmark Scout’s programs against the market and industry on a regular basis to ensure competitive positioning for both prospective talent as well as our internal equity for our current employees. Ensure compliance with applicable compensation and benefits regulations and governance requirements. Learning, Development & Engagement Oversee Scout’s employee learning and development programs, ensuring employees at all levels have access to meaningful growth experiences that align to Scouts growth trajectory. Drive employee engagement strategy including listening mechanisms, survey design, results analysis, and action planning. Lead recognition and onboarding programming that reinforces Scout’s culture, values, and sense of belonging. Partner with HR business partners and senior leaders on performance management processes and individual development plans. Build Scout’s talent development infrastructure to identify and accelerate high-potential employees. People Analytics & Insights Monitor compensation equity, engagement scores, attrition trends, and development outcomes to inform decisions and priorities. Use data and analytics to evaluate the effectiveness and equity of compensation, benefits, and development programs. Build reporting tools and dashboards that give leaders visibility into the health of the employee experience. Location & Travel Expectations : This role will be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC . This role requires 4 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events. Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. Travel : Domestic and minimal international travel may be required as business needs evolve. Valid driver’s license required. Passport required What you’ll bring We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here’s what else you’ll bring: Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree, MBA, or advanced HR-related degree preferred. 15+ years of progressive HR experience with significant experience in total rewards, compensation, or employee development leadership. Demonstrated expertise in compensation plan design, benefits program management, and total rewards strategy. Demonstrated ability to build strong business partnerships and collaborate across the organization, engaging key HR partners and incorporating business needs into the development of practical, scalable solutions. Experience leading executive compensation programs and supporting Board-level compensation governance preferred. Strong understanding of employee learning and development best practices, engagement methodologies, and leadership development. Data-driven decision maker with strong analytical capabilities and comfort using workforce insights to inform recommendations. Experience building or scaling people programs in high-growth, transformational, or startup environments. Exceptional communication, collaboration, and executive presence, paired with genuine warmth and care for both business priorities and people needs. Ability to operate with influence at all levels of the organization. High integrity, sound judgment, and a commitment to inclusion, fairness, and respect. Experience in automotive, manufacturing, technology, , or industrial environments preferred. What you’ll gain The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave Corporate Vehicle Program with: Eligibility for 1 assigned vehicle A mobility stipend Pay Transparency This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate’s skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range = $210,000.00 - $255,000.00 Internal leveling code: M5 Notice to applicants: To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. Residing in San Francisco : Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Residing in Los Angeles : Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. Residing in New York City : This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City. Equal Opportunity Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you’re ready to drive change and make history, apply now! Overview The Manager, Prototype & Pre-Series Management leads the operational planning, coordination, readiness, and execution of Scout’s engineering Prototype, prototype, and pre-series vehicle activities. The role provides leadership across engineering fleet operations, pre-series management, test-location and proving-ground coordination, and vehicle/test readiness. It establishes an integrated operating model to ensure vehicles, test assets, locations, logistics, and validation activities are aligned with vehicle-program priorities. Serving as the central operational interface among Vehicle Engineering, Verification & Validation, Prototype Builds, Logistics, Procurement, test organizations, proving grounds, and external partners, the Manager ensures that vehicles and supporting resources are available in the right configuration, at the right location, and at the right time. The role leads the team responsible for day-to-day execution while maintaining overall accountability for operational priorities, resource allocation, issue escalation, process maturity, and transparent reporting to program leadership. What you’ll do Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: Prototype & Pre-Series Operations Lead the operational management of Scout’s engineering prototype, prototype, and pre-series vehicle activities. Establish priorities for vehicle readiness, allocation, configuration, usage, movement, maintenance, and availability based on engineering and validation requirements. Ensure engineering vehicles are available in the required configuration and condition to support development and validation activities. Establish standardized processes for vehicle intake, handover, tracking, readiness, storage, and release. Provide leadership and escalation support when vehicle availability, configuration, logistics, or operational constraints put program activities at risk. Pre-Series & Validation Readiness Lead operational coordination between prototype and pre-series vehicle availability and planned engineering and validation activities. Ensure alignment among Design Verification Plans (DVPs), vehicle availability, vehicle configuration, test requests, test locations, and program timing. Establish visibility of planned versus executed validation activities and ensure significant gaps and risks are escalated. Support prototype-build and vehicle-program milestone readiness through structured status reporting and risk management. Drive resolution of conflicts involving vehicle demand, test priorities, available assets, timing, and engineering requirements. Engineering Fleet & Vehicle Logistics Provide leadership for engineering fleet operations across applicable Scout locations. Oversee vehicle receiving, release, internal handover, storage, transportation, operational readiness, and real-time status visibility. Oversee domestic and international movement of prototype and engineering vehicles, including associated documentation and import/export requirements. Ensure appropriate management of vehicle permits, insurance, compliance records, and prototype identifiers. Oversee benchmark and competitor-vehicle operations where applicable and drive effective fleet utilization. Test Locations & Proving Grounds Provide leadership for the identification, planning, evaluation, and utilization of proving grounds and other vehicle test locations. Ensure test-site capabilities, availability, timing, and cost are aligned with engineering and validation requirements. Oversee coordination with proving-ground operators, test agencies, and external partners. Ensure test locations and associated logistics are secured early enough to support program and seasonal test requirements. Support commercial and operational coordination with Procurement, Legal, and external test partners. Operational Planning & Program Integration Translate vehicle-program and validation requirements into an integrated operating plan across vehicles, test locations, logistics, and supporting resources. Establish short- and medium-term priorities based on program milestones and identify resource bottlenecks early. Coordinate dependencies across Engineering, V&V, Prototype Builds, Logistics, Procurement, and external partners. Implement structured processes for identifying and escalating issues affecting program execution. Drive standardization of processes, tools, and reporting across prototype and pre-series operations. A valid driver’s license and passport are required. Significant experience with prototype, prototype, pre-series, engineering fleet, vehicle validation, or vehicle-development operations. Demonstrated experience leading teams and complex cross-functional operations. Strong understanding of vehicle-development and validation processes, including DVPs, prototype/pre-series builds, vehicle test activities, and program milestones. Experience coordinating engineering vehicle fleets, prototype logistics, vehicle readiness, and/or major test campaigns. Ability to manage competing vehicle, test, resource, and schedule priorities and to drive effective risk mitigation and escalation. Strong stakeholder-management, analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills. Comfort operating in a fast-paced development environment with evolving processes and priorities. Experience supporting complete vehicle-development programs from early prototypes through pre-series maturity. Familiarity with major vehicle proving grounds and external test providers. Experience with domestic and international prototype-vehicle logistics and import/export considerations. Experience with engineering and program-management systems such as JIRA, Polarion, or Teamcenter. Experience establishing operational KPIs, dashboards, and management reporting. Experience in a startup or rapidly scaling automotive organization What you’ll gain The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.
