items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it. This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation. You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team. We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Database platform (approx. 60%) Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths. Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions. Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene. Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path. Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require. Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability. Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%) Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes. Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them. Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant. Team, incidents, and collaboration Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence. Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person. Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS Required — PostgreSQL depth 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning. Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services. Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables. Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies. Required — Infrastructure and ways of working Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS. Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling. Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation). Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes. Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists. Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued). Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load. Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows. Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional). MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-senior-database-reliability-engineer-i-germany-austria-uk

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Texas, United States, AMER From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role The Enterprise Account Executive will drive towards aggressive new customer and partner revenue goals, while growing our footprint in the Enterprise market. This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of Texas in the United States. Please note that the compensation listed below does not include commission (uncapped 50/50 split) or RSU value. What You'll Do Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, alliances, operations, and analytics to drive pipeline generation and exceed revenue goals. Accelerate the growth & adoption of Fivetran in the Enterprise Market through value-driven sales cycles. Lead in-depth discovery and demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise customers’ data challenges, identify required capabilities and positive business outcomes to drive towards valuable long term customer engagements. Speak comfortably about Fivetran’s vision to a broad range of audiences from C-level executives to individual contributors. Seek out and land deals with new Enterprise target accounts, then look to grow their footprint with Fivetran through new use cases, cross-sells and expansion. Build strategic relationships with partners in order to identify new opportunities and accelerate deal cycles. Forecast accurately and provide clear visibility on sales and revenue performance by actively managing and progressing opportunities. Skills We're Looking For 8+ years of large enterprise software sales experience and well-developed pattern recognition for navigating complex organizations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold multiple stakeholders accountable throughout a complex value-driven sales cycle. In-depth familiarity with the modern data technology industry and key players. You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities. You thrive in an extremely fast-paced, ever changing work environment. You’re able to keep up with a highly motivated team in a market that is growing extremely fast. You are extremely organized. You are able to juggle lots of things at once while not letting anything drop. You are a strategic thinker. You are able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way. You are a problem solver. You are resilient and creative, able to be resourceful to proactively seek out a solution to a problem. You are enthusiastic! You exhibit passion and excitement for your work and you have a can-do attitude. Previous experience with data integration, database, ETL, or business intelligence technologies is a plus, but not required Please note that the base + uncapped commission compensation listed below does not include RSU value. This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings. As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in-person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. This bootcamp, held at one of our designated company locations, requires travel and is a mandatory part of the onboarding process. The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process. Pay Range $151,351 — $189,189 USD OTE (On Target Earning) $302,702 — $378,378 USD Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in Forbes . Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability. items.description: Nium, the Leader in Real-Time Global Payments Nium, the leading global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments, was founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. With the onset of the global economy, its payments infrastructure is shaping how banks, fintechs, and businesses everywhere collect, convert, and disburse funds instantly across borders. Its payout network supports 100 currencies and spans 190+ countries, 100 of which in real-time. Funds can be disbursed to accounts, wallets, and cards and collected locally in 40 markets. Nium’s growing card issuance business is already available in 34 countries. Nium holds regulatory licenses and authorizations in more than 40 countries, enabling seamless onboarding, rapid integration, and compliance – independent of geography. The company is co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore. About the Role: Join our Risk & Compliance team as part of the Compliance PMO supporting the Chief Risk and Compliance Officer (CRCO). You will work closely with the Global and Local teams within the Risk & Compliance function to drive strong governance, impact management and leadership decision support. This is a PMO role with a Compliance lens, as you ensure global and local Compliance initiatives are organised and translate requirements into clear actions, accountable owners and deadlines. Key Responsibilities: Support the tracking, coordination and maintenance of Risk & Compliance initiatives across all regions, including status updates, dependencies, and risk logs. Maintain central SharePoint or Confluence spaces for document control and artefact management. Assist in establishing effective communication channels with relevant stakeholders. This involves providing regular updates, facilitating collaboration, and addressing stakeholder concerns to ensure alignment and transparency. Support the Risk & Compliance Monthly Updates to CRCO, including status updates, risks, issues, follow-up actions and timely resolution of issues & actions. Assist in preparing leadership-facing materials such as dashboards, status decks, and summary write-ups under the direction of the team. Support annual and quarterly planning activities, including data collation for regional reviews, budget and vendor tracking, and HC planning inputs. Assist in managing external requests from banking and network partners globally from a Risk & Compliance standpoint. Support the continuous improvement initiatives within Risk & Compliance function to increase overall effectiveness and efficiency. Assist in documenting operating model, ownership and process maps, and escalation paths for key compliance processes. Support relevant initiatives in execution, evidence gathering or validating outcomes. Requirements: Prior internship or full-time exposure to Financial Crime Compliance, PMO, Management Consulting, or a similar cross-functional role (internships count). Strong analytical mindset with the ability to organise information clearly and support structured problem-solving. Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear, well-organised materials. Detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working with data and spreadsheets/dashboards. Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills for dashboards, reporting, and executive presentations. Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment. Eagerness to learn, take ownership of assigned tasks, and grow into broader strategy and PMO responsibilities. Proficiency in use of AI technology to assist in day to day operations. What we offer at Nium We Value Performance: Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work. We Care for Our Employees: The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24 ⁄ 7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office). We Upskill Ourselves: We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend. We Celebrate Together: We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more! We Thrive with Diversity: Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone. For more detailed region specific benefits : https://www.nium.com/careers#careers-perks For more information visit www.nium.com Depending on your location, certain laws may regulate the way Nium manages the data of candidates. By submitting your job application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand our Candidate Privacy Notice located at www.nium.com/privacy/candidate-privacy-notice. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: Here at Scout Motors, we’re carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you’re ready to drive change and make history, apply now! What you’ll do Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans outlining key milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and critical paths to ensure cross-functional alignment and on-time program execution. Drive cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Design, R&D, and Operations to deliver high-quality product features. Support alignment across teams by clarifying requirements, identifying potential blockers, and proposing well-reasoned solutions. Manage key stakeholder relationships: Act as a trusted advisor to internal and external partners, presenting solutions that align with broader business goals. Be a natural relationship builder and clear communicator. Operationalize products: Oversee the roll-out of technical solutions to the marketplace, ensuring performance, reliability and consumer adoption achieve agreed upon outcomes. Drive technical excellence: Collaborate with engineering teams to make informed trade-offs and support scalable, secure product development. Apply working knowledge of APIs, data systems, and platform capabilities to contribute to sound technical decisions. Location & Travel Expectations : This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in San Ramon, California This role requires 3 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events. Subject to change. Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. What you’ll bring We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here’s what else you’ll bring: Experience: 8+ years of program management experience, with a strong emphasis on web and mobile customer experience. Demonstrated success in building and launching complex digital experiences enjoyed by millions of people around the world. Experienced with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, Smartsheet, and project reporting dashboards. Proficient with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) and eager to integrate them into your workflow Automotive experience is a plus but not required. Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of system architecture, APIs, mobile and web applications. Experience with enterprise-level systems such as CRM, ERP, or equivalent platforms. Skills: Exceptional communication and collaboration skills to influence and align diverse stakeholders. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks to keep programs on track. Support frameworks such as Agile, Scrum, or SAFe to drive continuous improvement and delivery efficiency. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred. What you’ll gain The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave Pay Transparency This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate’s skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial Base Salary Range: $140,000.00 - $170,000.00 California Initial Base Salary Range: $154,000.00 - $187,000.00 Internal Leveling Code: IC8 Notice to applicants: To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. Residing in San Francisco : Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Residing in Los Angeles : Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. Residing in New York City : This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City. Equal Opportunity Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: United States URL: http://www.halcyon.ai What we do: Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware. Who we are: Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers. As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs. The Role At Halcyon, we’re building a world-class anti-ransomware platform grounded in innovation and resilience. As part of that vision, we’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our cloud team. You’ll lead the development and evolution of our data platform and API services, working within a modern tech stack that blends Scala and Rust. You’ll join a team focused on building scalable, maintainable backend systems that serve both internal and customer-facing functions. Your primary focus will be on Rust and Scala services, with opportunities to shape our transition to Rust where it makes sense. Python development experience is highly valued, particularly for supporting our security analysis platform which includes malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning workflows. Responsibilities Lead the design and delivery of features across our data platform and public API services, including ingestion, transformation, and enrichment of security data. Drive system design, architecture, and data flow decisions in partnership with product and platform engineering. Build, deploy, and own Scala-based backend services in production, keeping them reliable, secure, and performant. Help shape and execute our migration of selected APIs from Scala to Rust, ensuring consistency and continuity along the way. Set the bar for code quality, documentation, and operational excellence. Lead design reviews, code reviews and take part in on-call and incident response. Support and enhance our Python-based security analysis platform, including malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning model workflows. Skills and Qualifications 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with recent experience in a JVM-based codebase. A track record of designing and owning distributed systems from start to finish. Experience with Rust, or a well-formed view of when it’s the right tool, and the ability to help guide a migration. Strong understanding of APIs, messaging systems (Kafka), and modern data stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, OpenSearch). Experience building services in a cloud-native environment, preferably AWS. Prior work on security products, data pipelines, or high-availability systems. Python development experience, particularly with security analysis tools and malware detection frameworks (YARA, PE analysis, binary analysis). They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their
items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Canada (Remote) About the Role: An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. Our Core Technologies Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. What You'll Do • Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout • Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge • Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff • Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most • Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs • Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers • Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context • Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior • Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts • Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone • Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks What We Look For: • 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles • Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails • Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates • Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. • Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved • Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response • Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal Nice To Have: • Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) • Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling • Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design • Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) • Conversation design or UX writing experience What We Offer You: • Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance • Flexible PTO • Opportunities for professional growth and development • Paid parental leave • Health & wellness initiatives To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-ai-experience-engineer-conversational-ai

items.title: AI Researcher – Multilingual Data
items.summary: About the RoleWe’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains.
items.description: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains. You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Design and execute research on multilingual datasets , including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design) Research and improve cross-lingual transfer , alignment, and robustness in large language models Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate Translate research insights into practical improvements in production models What We’re Looking For Strong background in NLP / ML research , with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages Solid understanding of: Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.) Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment Nice to Have Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling Experience training or evaluating large language models Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA) Why Join Us Real ownership over research direction and impact A team that values papers and production Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
items.summary: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. Duties · Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients · Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success · Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required · Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services. · Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines · Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues · Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management · Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment · Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices · Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives Our Technology Stack · Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA · Documentation – Hudu · RMM – Intune / Immybot · Networking – Meraki · Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365 · Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon · Door Access – Avigilon Qualification · 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support · Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry · Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service · Proven experience leading IT projects · A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications · Background in providing direct end-user support · High level of attention to detail · Excellent verbal and written communication skills · IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent) · Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents Our Core Values Dream Big, Then Make it Real We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Do, rather than talk and tell. Client Driven Results Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results. When they succeed, we succeed. Own Your Progress We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution. We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process. Basic Requirements • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English • Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States • Active use of Gmail and social media platforms • Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection • Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher) • Access to a personal computer Assessment You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

items.description: Du kennst die Welt der Sparkassen und möchtest deine Erfahrung nutzen, um moderne Finanzprozesse aktiv mitzugestalten? Please read on! Unser Kunde ist eine spezialisierte Unternehmensberatung, die Banken und Sparkassen bei der digitalen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse begleitet. Mit tiefem bankfachlichem Wissen und einem starken Verständnis für IT und Digitalisierung verbindet das Unternehmen Fachbereiche und technische Lösungen. Dabei entstehen Projekte, die nicht nur Prozesse optimieren, sondern die Zukunft der Finanzbranche aktiv mitprägen. Gesucht wird eine Persönlichkeit, die ihre Erfahrung aus dem Sparkassenumfeld einbringen und sich langfristig in Richtung Beratung, Digitalisierung und Projektarbeit weiterentwickeln möchte. Werde Teil dieser Entwicklung als Consultant Sparkassen Finanzgruppe & Digitalisierung Das erwartet dich Attraktive Vergütung mit einem Jahresbruttogehalt zwischen 51.000 € und 59.000 € (Junior) bis 75.000 € (Senior), abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und Entwicklung. Klare Karriereperspektive durch ein strukturiertes Modell vom Consultant bis zum Managing Consultant mit individueller fachlicher Spezialisierung. Flexibles Arbeiten mit Remote Work und spannenden Kundenprojekten vor Ort. Die Einsätze verteilen sich in der Regel etwa 50/50. Mobilität durch eine BahnCard 100 oder ab Consultant Level die Möglichkeit eines Firmenwagens. Mitarbeiterbeteiligung ermöglicht dir, am langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg teilzuhaben. Weiterentwicklung wird durch die interne Academy sowie externe Weiterbildungen aktiv gefördert. Familienfreundlichkeit wird großgeschrieben, unter anderem durch Unterstützung bei Kinderbetreuungskosten für Kindergarten oder Tagesmutter. Zusätzliche Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Bikeleasing, monatlicher Nettozuschuss und moderne Hardware mit MacBook und iPhone. Teamkultur auf Augenhöhe mit flachen Hierarchien, regelmäßigen Events, Social Days und einem starken Zusammenhalt im Team. Work Life Balance durch Gleitzeit, flexible Arbeitsmodelle sowie zusätzliche freie Tage an Weihnachten und Silvester. Deine Aufgaben Begleitung von Digitalisierungsprojekten im Umfeld der Sparkassen Finanzgruppe mit Fokus auf fachliche Beratung und Prozessoptimierung. Analyse bestehender Geschäftsprozesse sowie Entwicklung geeigneter Lösungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und internen Teams. Erstellung von Fachkonzepten und Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen für IT Bereiche. Unterstützung bei Tests, Abnahmen und der Qualitätssicherung neuer Anwendungen und Prozesse. Übernahme von Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete oder Teilprojekte inklusive Planung, Abstimmung und Reporting. Mitarbeit in unterschiedlichen Projektumfeldern wie Business Analyse, Projektmanagement, Testmanagement oder Schulung & Training. Das bringst du als Consultant Digitalisierung Sparkassen mit: Sparkassen Know how bringst du durch eine Ausbildung bei einer Sparkasse, einem Verbundpartner oder ein Studium mit Finanzbezug mit. Berufserfahrung im Sparkassenumfeld hast du bereits gesammelt und kennst die Abläufe sowie Herausforderungen der Finanzbranche. Projektpraxis konntest du idealerweise bereits in Bereichen wie Prozessanalyse, Business Analyse, Organisation, Testmanagement oder Schulungen sammeln. Digitales Interesse zeichnet dich aus und du möchtest dein bankfachliches Wissen mit modernen IT Themen und Digitalisierung verbinden. Kommunikationsstärke hilft dir dabei, Kunden, Fachbereiche und Projektteams sicher zusammenzubringen. Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands bringst du mit, da regelmäßige Einsätze beim Kunden Bestandteil der Rolle sind. Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau ermöglichen dir eine professionelle Kommunikation im Beratungsumfeld. Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist zeichnen dich aus und du möchtest dich fachlich sowie persönlich weiterentwickeln. Du möchtest nicht nur bestehende Prozesse verwalten, sondern die digitale Zukunft der Sparkassen aktiv mitgestalten? Du suchst eine Beratung, in der du als Mensch gesehen wirst und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln kannst? 🎯 Dann sende uns deinen Lebenslauf. items.title: 3D Spatial Data Expert (AI Community)
items.summary: About the Role: At TELUS Digital, we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality.
items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. Qualification path What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Payment: Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour Our Payment terms are defined for each project. Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you. Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

We're looking for a Paid Media Coordinator to help grow Zanda's reach and connect more health professionals with the tools they need to run successful practic
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Australia URL: https://zandahealth.com/eu/ Paid Media Coordinator Are you someone who loves building relationships, spotting new opportunities, and bringing great ideas to life? We're looking for a Paid Media Coordinator to help grow Zanda's reach and connect more health professionals with the tools they need to run successful practices. In this hands-on role, you'll manage our advertising, sponsorship, and association partnerships across international markets. From discovering new opportunities to promote Zanda and negotiating great deals to coordinating the deliverables and measuring their impact, you'll play an important part in how we grow. You'll work within our Marketing team while having the autonomy to make things happen. What You’ll Be Doing Build and own relationships with associations, publishers, media partners, agencies, and vendors across our key international markets. Identify and pursue new opportunities for advertising, sponsorships, and partnerships that increase Zanda's brand awareness and reach. Evaluate and negotiate advertising opportunities, securing competitive rates, valuable placements, and partnerships that deliver results. Coordinate campaigns from start to finish, working with internal teams and external partners to keep creative assets, approvals, tracking, and deadlines on track. Manage Programmatic Advertising across channels such as Paid Social and Display, and support opportunities in Paid Search and emerging advertising platforms. Manage campaign operations, including advertising calendars, budgets, pipelines, and vendor coordination. Track and evaluate performance, using campaign data and insights to identify what's working, recommend improvements, and maximize the value of our advertising investments. What You’ll Bring to the Team 2-3+ years of relevant experience in marketing, media, partnerships, sponsorships, or campaign management. Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with external partners, vendors, agencies, or stakeholders. Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the confidence to explore opportunities, discuss terms, and secure mutually beneficial outcomes. Experience coordinating campaigns or partnerships end-to-end, balancing multiple stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently. A good understanding of campaign performance and the ability to use data to evaluate results and make practical recommendations, alongside experience supporting creative briefs, advertising copy, or landing-page improvements. Bonus Points If You Have: Experience working with professional associations, publishers, sponsorships, or media partnerships across international markets. Familiarity with Paid Social, Display, Paid Search, or emerging advertising channels. Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or project management platforms. An understanding of marketing metrics such as CAC, CPA, ROAS, attribution, or UTM tracking. Experience in SaaS, HealthTech, or using AI and automation tools to improve marketing workflows. Who You Are A natural relationship builder. You enjoy connecting with people, creating genuine partnerships, and aren't afraid to negotiate or ask for a better deal. Proactive and resourceful. You spot opportunities, take initiative, and find ways to move things forward without waiting to be asked. Organized and detail-oriented. You can juggle multiple moving pieces while keeping track of the small details that make a big difference. Someone who takes ownership. You're comfortable making decisions, following through on commitments, and being accountable for outcomes. Adaptable and collaborative. You enjoy working with different people, navigating changing priorities and company direction, and finding solutions along the way. Why You’ll Love Working With Us ✅ Work from Anywhere We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together. ✅ Flexibility & Autonomy We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. Outside of agreed core hours that align to your role, your time is yours - whether that’s doing the school run or squeezing in a midday gym class. ✅ Generous Paid Time Off Balance matters. We offer paid time off and expect you to take it - because rest fuels great work. ✅ High Trust, Results Driven We strip away red tape so you can focus on impact. No pointless meetings or rigid hierarchies - just space to move fast, solve problems, and make a difference. ✅ Growth & Innovation You’ll be encouraged to experiment, stretch your skills, and bring YOUR bold ideas to the table. Everyone at Zanda contributes to shaping what’s next. ✅ Inspiring Teammates You’ll work alongside passionate, curious people who support and cheer each other on - even across time zones. Collaboration is how we win. ✅ Meaningful Impact Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Your work will directly improve lives. ✅ Competitive Pay We hire the best people - wherever they are - and we make sure they feel valued and well-rewarded for the work they do. About Zanda Zanda is a fast-growing, globally loved practice management platform that helps health professionals run smooth, efficient practices - and spend more time caring for their patients. We’re used by thousands of clinics across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, the US, and Canada, and we’re just getting started. Our mission is simple: make health practice management easy and enjoyable. To do that, we need brilliant, passionate people who are excited by innovation, love solving complex problems, and thrive in fast-moving environments. At Zanda, you’ll join a globally distributed team that’s small enough to move fast and think big - and driven enough to deliver work that makes a real impact. We live our values every day: Growth: We stretch ourselves, learn constantly, and support each other’s development. Reliability: We follow through on our commitments and show up for our team and customers. Impact: Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Teamwork: We win together - celebrating wins, sharing ideas, and having each other’s backs. Zanda collects and processes your personal data for the purposes of managing employment candidate application and recruitment-related activities as well as for organisational planning purposes, for further detail, please refer to the Zanda Health Privacy Policy . This is an exciting time to join Zanda. We’re self-funded, scaling quickly, and building something that truly changes lives. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a meaningful difference - we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zanda-health-performance-marketing-paid-media

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Chicago | Salt Lake City | Remote (US) Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io. At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. As a Commercial Account Executive, you'll play a key role in driving new business growth by acquiring net-new customers for Gong Foundations. You will own and manage the full sales cycle, with 100% focus on outbound prospecting. RESPONSIBILITIES Source and manage a pipeline of net-new prospects through proactive outbound prospecting, from lead to close focused on Gong Foundations. Clearly articulate and demonstrate our value proposition, creating excitement and enthusiasm among prospects. Build relationships with net-new logos to drive them through the sales cycle to close Maintain weekly sales forecast and achieve new business quota quarterly. Run and implement 7 to 10 day pilot program. QUALIFICATIONS Located in the Lehi area within a commutable distance to our office, with the ability to work our hybrid schedule of 3 days/week in-office. 6 months+ of relevant new business/net-new logo closing experience for Commercial. Previous SaaS and enterprise software experience preferred. Strong previous outbound prospecting experience — you're comfortable building your own pipeline, not just working inbound leads. Demonstrated success in achieving new business sales goals (President's Club, Rep of the Year, etc.) Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. Comfortable selling to VP and C-Suite executives, navigating multiple decision makers within an organization — experience selling to sales leaders specifically is a plus. PERKS & BENEFITS We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs. Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. 401(k) program to help you invest in your future. Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. Paid parental leave to support you and your family. Company-wide recharge days each quarter. Monthly stipend to help make your work from home days more comfortable. The annual OTE for this position is $130,000 Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets. We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect. We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored. Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. To review Gong's privacy policy, visit https://www.gong.io/gong-io-job-candidates-privacy-notice/ for more details To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gong-io-commercial-account-executive

AI is a core part of how we work . AI can already produce content quickly a
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems , the company behind WPML , Toolset , and PTC , we’re looking for an experienced Head of Content and Editorial who knows what makes content great and can take ownership of content quality and performance. AI is a core part of how we work . AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results. We’re looking for someone who has experience working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful. You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it. What You’ll Work On Content strategy and editorial direction – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why. Content quality and editing – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable. AI-assisted content creation – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards. Content performance – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it. Content experiments – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works. Collaboration with marketing and product teams – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them. What We’re Looking For You’ve managed small teams of skilled writers and know how to improve and maintain high content quality. You have excellent editing and copywriting skills. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement. You know how to use AI effectively to create and edit content. You’re comfortable working with metrics and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn't. You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results. You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business. You’re hands-on and independent. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions. You have experience with technology, software, SaaS, or technical content. We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in high-quality editorial environments, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential. We’re not looking for someone whose main experience is managing large volumes of low-quality content. We want someone who knows how to make good content exceptional. Why Join Us OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007 . WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide . You’ll have real ownership of our editorial direction, work closely with our CEO, marketing, and product teams, and help shape how we create high-quality content with AI. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and see the impact of your work through real results. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-content-and-editorial
