items.title: FirstPrinciples Research Fellow
items.summary: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe.
items.description: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe. We're developing an intelligent system that can explore theoretical frameworks, reason across disciplines, and generate novel insights to tackle the deepest unsolved problems in physics. By combining AI, symbolic reasoning, and autonomous research capabilities, we're developing a platform that goes beyond analyzing existing knowledge to actively contribute to physics research. Our goal is to accelerate progress on the questions that have captivated humanity for centuries. We operate as a global nonprofit organization , with a Canadian foundation, a US-based 501(c)(3). As part of this effort, we are launching a Research Fellowship Program for advanced AI and physics researchers. Fellows will work directly with the FirstPrinciples Research and Engineering teams to design, test, and implement state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods and applications that will be integrated into the core AI Physicist system. This is not a paper-only fellowship and your work will go straight into production, helping shape how scientific research is performed. What You will DoAs a Research Fellow, you will own a well-scoped research direction that contributes directly to the AI Physicist's ability to reason about physics. Core Objectives: Improve Theo’s ability to produce scientifically sound, high-quality outputs in 2026; Introduce new ideas, methods, and approaches that meaningfully shift system performance; Bring deep domain expertise (PhD+ level) in one or more targeted research areas. Research Areas & Responsibilities Fundamental Model Research : Research, design, and test novel model architectures that combine academic literature, NLP, symbolic reasoning, and structured scientific workflows. Prototype and build embedding representations for physical concepts, mathematical objects, and logical structures, enabling models to reason over equations, abstractions, and scientific constraints rather than surface text alone. Investigate alternatives to transformer-based architectures and deliver concrete recommendations. Design and run targeted experiments to evaluate new architectural ideas, using empirical results to guide the development of next-generation model architectures. Develop reinforcement learning loops that enable models to run internal and independent thought experiment. Multimodal Data & Benchmarking : Design and automate scalable data ingestion pipelines that aggregate scientific literature, metadata, equations, and experimental data. Create custom benchmarks to measure physical understanding, mathematical reasoning, and failure modes in scientific reasoning and abstraction. Refine and release curated datasets and baselines once internal validation is complete. Training, Testing & Safety : Run and track model training jobs while managing compute usage and budget constraints. Design sandbox environments for controlled autonomous exploration. Build evaluation frameworks using visual and statistical tools to identify strengths and blind spots. Implement tests and guardrails that flag low-quality or unsafe outputs. Maintain internal issue tracking with clear failure modes and fixes. Collaboration & Technical Guidance : Work closely with engineers to ensure research is feasible and production-ready. Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Present regular research updates tied to defined milestones. Who This Fellowship Is ForWe are looking for researchers who: Can operate independently and own a problem end-to-end. Are motivated by ambitious, long-horizon goals. Have strong builder instincts, not just theory. Value rigor, clarity, and intellectual honesty. Are comfortable engaging with exploratory, incomplete results. Typical profiles include: PhD or postdoctoral researchers in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Theoretical Physics, or a closely related field. Track record of research in either: model architectures, representation learning, or reasoning systems (CS/ML path); or mathematical, physical, or formal reasoning applied to fundamental problems (physics path). Demonstrated ability to translate abstract theory into testable computational systems. Comfortable working across disciplinary boundaries. Program Structure 6-12 month engagement with full-time or equivalent commitment Fully remote Fellows participate in projects and are expected to produce outputs (code, models, and other deliverables) Fixed stipend for the full term How to Express Interest:If this resonates, we welcome an expression of interest, including: Resume; Description of your research background; Primary areas of expertise; and Relevant recent work. Join us at FirstPrinciples and be a part of a transformative journey where science drives progress and unlocks the potential of humanity. Originally posted on Himalayas

What You'll Do You'll have the freedom to shape our content marketing, experiment with new ideas, and see the impact of your work. Create content that makes a difference : write engaging website pages, articles, emails, and campaigns that attract and connect with customers. Own the content direction : identify opportunities, set priorities, and bring ideas from concept to publication. Make the most of AI : use AI tools to research, create, improve, and scale content while keeping quality high. Grow our visibility : improve SEO and AI-search presence (GEO/AEO) to help more people discover our products. Build connections : collaborate with partners, customers, and product experts to create content that stands out. Turn insights into results : track performance, experiment, learn what works, and continuously improve. You'll work closely with our CEO, product teams, and marketing colleagues, with plenty of room to bring your own ideas to life. You've owned successful content marketing projects and can show the results of your work. You are hands-on with SEO, email marketing, and content distribution , and know how they contribute to business growth. You're AI-native, using AI tools confidently to create better content and work more effectively. You understand customers, products, and competition , and can turn these insights into compelling content. You're creative, proactive, and independent . We're a profitable, self-funded software company with a global customer base and a fully remote team. You'll have the chance to own content marketing for an established product, work directly with decision-makers, experiment with the latest AI tools, and make a visible impact on our business. We value great ideas, initiative, and people who enjoy turning opportunities into results. What We Offer 100% remote work with an international team. Paid time off and national holidays to recharge. Smart, supportive, and self-driven colleagues from around the world. Freedom to experiment, grow, and make a real impact. Love creating content, exploring what AI can do, and seeing your ideas turn into real results? We'd love to meet you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-content-marketing-lead

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: URL: https://careers.mozaiq.com About LiftPilot LiftPilot is an AI-powered website personalization platform for B2B companies. We help marketing and growth teams give every visitor a tailored website experience, turning more traffic into engagement, qualified pipeline and conversions. The product is built, enterprise-grade and in the market. We’re live with our first pilots and the results so far have been exceptional. The role LiftPilot is early enough that how we sell is still an open question, and you’d be the person answering it — figuring out who bites, what lands, which deals are worth chasing and which aren’t. You won’t be doing that from a standing start: the founding team is deep in this market, so the product knowledge, the context and the second opinions are all a message away. You’d run the whole cycle yourself, target list through to signed. The pipeline you work is the pipeline you build, and what you learn building it is what LiftPilot’s sales motion becomes. If you want a process to follow, this isn’t it. If you want to be the reason there’s a process at all, let’s talk. What you'll do Build your own target list and book every meeting through your own outreach: email, LinkedIn, phone and events. Sell to VP-level and above marketing, demand gen and growth leaders at B2B companies. Run discovery calls, and prepare a tailored demo for each first meeting. Help your champion make the case internally, and position LiftPilot against existing tools, agencies and internal builds. Negotiate and close new business, and set each new customer up for a smooth start. Keep an accurate, honest pipeline in the CRM. Bring what you hear from buyers back into the product. What you need 4+ years as a quota-carrying Account Executive closing new business in B2B SaaS, with a record of hitting your number. Selling to marketing leaders. You've sold to VP-level and above marketing, demand gen or growth leaders, not IT or finance. MarTech sales experience. You’ve sold marketing technology, such as website personalization, ABM, CRO, advertising, analytics or content tools. Early-stage experience. You've carried a number at an early-stage company, ideally as one of its first two salespeople. Self-sourced pipeline. Most of your pipeline came from your own outreach, and you can walk us through how you built it. Selling without proof. You've closed deals with no case studies or references to point to. Strong writing. You write cold emails that get replies. Organized and self-directed. You plan your week, follow up without being chased, and write down what's working. Curiosity about the product. You want to understand how it works, not just pitch it. You Close. You push deals to a decision rather than letting them drift. You’re comfortable asking for the signature, chasing the fourth follow-up, and naming the thing that’s blocking a deal instead of waiting it out. Nice to have Experience selling website personalization, ABM, CRO or experimentation platforms. Experience selling AI products. Experience in a founder-led sales team. Experience navigating buying committees in mid-market and enterprise deals. This role isn't for you if You need an SDR, a territory or an account list to hit your number. Most of your past pipeline came from inbound or leads you were handed. You're looking for a VP or Head of Sales title right away. What we offer Base salary: $100,000 to $125,000 USD, depending on experience. Uncapped commission on every deal you close. Fully remote. Direct access to the founder, product team, and to have real influence on how we sell. Room to grow as the sales team grows. Our hiring process 1. Intro call 2. Conversation with our founder 3. Pitch us. Run us through a pitch for your current company’s product, the way you’d do it on a real first call. 4. Paid take-home exercise We give you a list of companies; you show us how you'd prioritize them and draft your first outreach. 5. Team session. Walk us through your exercise, then work through a few real buyer scenarios with the team. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mozaiq-founding-account-executive

items.description: Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. Ro is the only company to offer nationwide telehealth, labs, and pharmacy services. This is enabled by Ro’s vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care. Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts. Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide. As Legal Counsel I, FDA Advertising & Promotion, you’ll be responsible for reviewing advertising, promotional, and other consumer-facing materials, ensuring they are compliant with FTC and FDA regulations and guidelines. You’ll partner closely with our Growth and Marketing teams to counsel on marketing content across the full spectrum of platforms, including websites, social media, podcasts, billboards, and TV. You’ll also help leverage AI and automation to make our advertising review processes more efficient and scalable. You have a strong knowledge of FDA and FTC advertising regulations and cases, and particularly with respect to prescription drugs and health products. You’re smart, collaborative, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment while handling several projects at the same time. Review a wide variety of promotional content within Ro’s collaborative medical-legal-marketing review process. This content includes: Facebook and Google ads, website pages, national TV spots, podcast reads, billboards, contests and sweepstakes, and more. Collaborate with Legal and cross-functional teams to implement, refine, and leverage AI-enabled and automated review workflows, helping improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of our advertising review process. Maintain company-wide guidelines and conduct trainings on advertising and promotion. Learn Ro’s business through and through to enable a multi-dimensional review of content. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support new strategic initiatives and advertising campaigns. Keep up with and understand the FTC regulatory environment, interpretation of regulations, and new case law. Stay abreast of changes in FDA and FTC regulations and industry trends in advertising, and monitor enforcement actions and relevant litigation. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Growth and Marketing. Demonstrate a willingness to grow and expand your expertise into adjacent areas of law to support the company’s evolving needs. What You’ll Bring to the Team: Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school. Active member in good standing of a state bar association. Two to four years of experience practicing FDA law, with knowledge of the regulatory landscape for the advertising and promotion of FDA-regulated products. Exceptional analytical, research, and writing skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships across all levels of the organization. Business-oriented mindset with the ability to translate legal advice into practical solutions. Comfort with emerging technologies and an interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve legal workflows. Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Self-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines. Team player with a collaborative work ethic. Passion for the telehealth industry and a desire to make a meaningful impact. A plus: experience using AI tools, workflow automation, or legal technology to improve legal review processes. The target base salary for this position ranges from $157,300-$195,000, in addition to a competitive equity and benefits package (as applicable). When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary. Ro recognizes the power of in-person collaboration, while supporting the flexibility to work anywhere in the United States. For our Ro’ers in the tri-state (NY) area, you will join us at HQ on Tuesdays and Thursdays. For those outside of the tri-state area, you will be able to join in-person collaborations throughout the year (i.e., during team on-sites). items.description: Precision for Medicine, Oncology and Rare Disease is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high retention rates compared to industry averages. We are now recruiting In-house CRA I/ In-house CRA II to join our team in Poland. Position summary The In-house CRA (IHCRA) provides centralized, non-site-facing support to CRAs and clinical project teams across the study lifecycle. The role supports consistent site oversight by maintaining study documentation and systems, reviewing and reconciling site-level data, preparing operational metrics, and completing agreed administrative follow-up activities. The IHCRA works in close collaboration with assigned CRAs and under the oversight of the CTM, escalating issues that require site-facing follow-up or clinical judgment. This is a regional support role. Direct communication with investigator sites and travel to site visits are not part of the core scope. The role may support studies across European countries and therefore does not require a local language for each supported country. Essential functions Provide non-site-facing operational and administrative support to assigned CRAs and clinical project teams throughout the study lifecycle. Prepare and maintain Investigator Site Files, including document distribution and coordination with shipping vendors where required. Route site communication and follow-up to the assigned CRA. Where an electronic Investigator Site File is implemented, review it remotely for completeness and identify documents requiring CRA follow-up or filing in the Trial Master File. Review documents received from CRAs and CTMs for legibility, completeness, correct orientation and filing readiness, and file documents in the eTMF in accordance with applicable processes. Review the eTMF for missing or expiring site documents and provide clear follow-up lists to the assigned CRA. Perform scheduled reconciliations between the Delegation of Authority Log, CTMS, eTMF and system-access records; create placeholders or update records as required by the agreed process. Set up and maintain assigned site-level data, milestones and activities in CTMS and other study-specific systems based on information provided by the CRA and/or CTM. Run available reports and provide assigned CRAs with agreed site metrics, including data-cleaning, enrollment and approval-status information where applicable. Support sample tracking and other vendor or study reconciliations, identify discrepancies, and provide findings to the CRA for site-facing follow-up. Complete agreed non-site-facing administrative actions arising from CRA site contacts or monitoring visits, such as coordinating supply orders, tracking completion and escalating delays. Provide documentation and tracking support for audit and inspection readiness under CRA or CTM direction. Support study tracking and reporting, maintain accurate activity status, and escalate risks, delays or data inconsistencies to the appropriate study team member. Perform all activities in accordance with ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, company and sponsor SOPs, project plans and study-specific procedures. Qualifications Minimum required Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent, preferably in a scientific, healthcare or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Initial experience in clinical research, clinical trial administration or study coordination within a CRO, pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment. Practical experience using CTMS, eTMF and other clinical trial systems or tools. Familiarity with ICH-GCP principles and clinical trial documentation. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Skills and competencies Strong organization, prioritization and follow-through across multiple studies, sites and deadlines. High attention to detail and the ability to perform accurate document and data review for extended periods. Ability to identify discrepancies, communicate findings clearly and escalate issues appropriately. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with CRAs, CTMs and cross-functional partners. Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Self-motivation, flexibility, teamwork and commitment to delivering on agreed responsibilities. Preferred Experience supporting multiple studies or countries in a centralized or regional clinical operations model. Experience with Veeva Clinical applications. Please, apply in English. #LI-EK1 #LI-Remote Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice. Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com. Recruitment Fraud Warning: Please be aware that fraudulent individuals and websites may impersonate Precision Medicine Group or its affiliates and attempt to obtain personal, financial, or banking information through fake job postings or employment offers. Precision Medicine Group will never request payment, banking details, or other sensitive financial information as part of the recruitment process. If you believe you have been targeted by a recruitment scam, we encourage you to report the incident to your local law enforcement authorities, consumer protection agency, or relevant cybercrime reporting organization in your country. Please also notify us at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com so we can investigate and take appropriate action. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment without employer sponsorship.

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.

items.title: Creative Director / Associate Creative Director

Collaborating with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, you’ll inspire cross-functional teams, develop human-centered creative strategies, and help build a scalable design practice rooted in experimentation, feedback, and continuous improvement.

items.summary: Superside is looking for a Lead Creative with a passion for AI to shape creative excellence across branding, landing pages, ads, social, print, and presentations. You’ll guide a global team of top-tier creatives, combining strategic leadership with hands-on craft to deliver human-centered, high-impact work for leading brands worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of creativity and innovation, elevating creative quality while helping evolve our capabilities through the thoughtful use of AI tools. You’ll act as both a mentor and a maker, fostering collaboration, empathy, and clarity across every project. You bring curiosity, composure, and humility to your leadership, helping others grow while delivering consistently outstanding creative work.
